topPRs.title: sep: int-mig-upg-0 OPCM v9 upgrade + migrate (executed)
topPRs.author: jelias2
topPRs.body:
Records two executed devnet tasks and the template change they needed.

**Depends on #1591 (OPCMUpgradeV900) and #1582 (OPCMMigrateV900)**, which this branch merges; rebase once they land.

## Template
`OPCMUpgradeV900`: optional `permitEthLockboxDeployment` (chain IDs). For chains whose portal has no ETHLockbox, adds the `PermittedProxyDeployment=ETHLockbox` extra instruction; without it the v9 OPCM reverts with `ETHLockbox` (`0x391074c9`). Setup requires each listed chain to be configured and to have no lockbox.

## Tasks
| Task | Tx |
|---|---|
| `120-int-mig-upg-0-opcm-upgrade-v900` | [`0x62189e05…c6dc`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x62189e057776d05fab11a99f6ba2a6d732737b702077ecbdb3dad323ff52c6dc) |
| `121-int-mig-upg-0-opcm-migrate-v900` | [`0xee5c8bd1…e15c`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0xee5c8bd191d877c1d2745e44da7bc8684f84f87227e8ef42a174b1ed7417e15c) |

Both used v9 OPCM `0xe09c…2ea9` (9.0.5), not a released `op-contracts/v9.0.0`. 121's `cannonKonaPrestate` (`0x03723b53…b041`) was built at `kona-node/v1.9.0` with infrastructure-services#1430.

## Gas
Sepolia charged well above forge's local estimates (13.6M vs ~5.1M for 120; 17.0M vs ~4.2M for 121), so default `just execute` runs out of gas (`GS013`). Executed with `--gas-estimate-multiplier` 300 and 500 respectively; that justfile change is **not** in this PR.

topPRs.title: tasks: add nonceless (hash-once) execution via UnorderedExecutionModule
topPRs.author: maurelian
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Tasks that set `hashOnceInput` in their `config.toml` become **nonceless**: every safe in the task signs with a hash-once value (the module's canonical `deriveHashOnce` of that string) in the nonce slot instead of a pinned nonce, and execution routes through the `UnorderedExecutionModule` (`hashOnceModule` in config, must be enabled on every safe) instead of `execTransaction`. Signatures survive nonce drift and task renumbering; replay protection is per `(safe, hashOnce)` on the module. Nonce-based tasks are completely unchanged, and templates need no modifications.

Details:
- `MultisigTask`: detection, hash-once nonce sourcing (nonce state overrides rejected), module execution routing, consumed-value pre-check with a clear error, validation asserts the hash-once value was consumed instead of nonce+1, sibling data-to-sign branch. Tenderly payload and op-txverify links are skipped for nonceless tasks (module-aware variants can come later).
- `GnosisSafeHashes`: builds the EIP-712 encoding locally for Safe >=1.5.0, which removed `encodeTransactionData()`.
- `OPCMTaskBase`: nonceless tasks expect zero root-safe state diffs (module execution touches neither nonce nor storage).
- Module contract: [ethereum-optimism/optimism#22675](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22675), deployed and verified on Sepolia at `0xADcbCff796a47D468fE8C0252FBe8d856d4e63D7`.

Executed on Sepolia against fresh Safe v1.5.0 instances with the module enabled:
- `sep/105-nonceless-welcome` — single safe; task was renumbered after signing with no effect on the signature.
- `sep/106-nonceless-nested-welcome` / `sep/107-nonceless-nested-fresh` — nested: child approval and root execution both via the module; no safe nonce moved at any step.

New tests cover drift invariance (single + nested), replay rejection, and config validation; the full regression suite passes unchanged.

Part of the San Diego hackathon nonceless (hash-once) Safe execution project.

topPRs.title: feat(template): add OPCMUpgradeV900
topPRs.author: ZakAyesh
topPRs.body:
Adds `OPCMUpgradeV900`, the upgrade half of the v9 (interop) release: it calls `OPContractsManagerV2.upgradeSuperchain` once, then `upgrade` per chain, so a set of chains already on op-contracts/v8 steps onto the v9 OPCM.

**Ordering:** this task runs before the `OPCMMigrateV900` task in #1582. `migrate` requires every chain to already be on the v9 OPCM.

Differences from `OPCMUpgradeV800`, all driven by the v9 OPCM:
- The only permitted upgrade instruction is `overrides.cfg.startingRespectedGameType`; the `startingAnchorRoot` override is rejected, so the anchor-root inputs are gone and the super-root anchor is carried forward. `_validate` asserts the respected game type landed and the anchor was not cleared.
- Version gate accepts any 9.x and checks `isPermittedUpgradeSequence` per chain.
- SUPER_CANNON_KONA is enabled when the factory already carries it (v8 cleared the CANNON_KONA impl it used to key off).
- `Challenger` is read with a tolerant lookup: super-game-only chains register none.

**Example task and simulation.** `sep/045-opcm-upgrade-v900` (Unichain Sepolia + OP Sepolia) simulates against the throwaway v9 OPCM (9.0.5) Andrea deployed on Sepolia on 2026-10-22 for template testing (`0xe09c417496c786abffefa676da9e11aab2c32ea9`, not an rc, no tag, no registry entry). The simulation passes end to end at fork block 11999987 with no validator errors for either chain. A real task must point at the released v9 OPCM. The example is not skipped in `simulate-all-templates`, so CI depends on that throwaway contract staying deployed; happy to add a skip like #1582 if preferred.

Setup tests: `test/template/OPCMUpgradeV900Setup.t.sol` (5 tests, Sepolia fork).

Open for review: the prestate in the example is the chains' current SUPER_CANNON_KONA prestate as a placeholder, and the ZK game path is unsupported as in V800.

topPRs.title: sep/112-114: OP Sepolia OPE key rotation (batcher, proposer, unsafe signer)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
OP Sepolia OP Enterprise key rotation in three tasks, sequenced by the Q4 multisig ceremonies calendar. sep/112 sets the OPE batcher (`0x64EDa4F93314ECd619bd4f79D8d1F8112A4E6e16`) and sep/114 the OPE unsafe block signer, both with `SetBatcherAndOrSigner` from the Sepolia FoundationUpgradeSafe; sep/113 rotates the `SUPER_PERMISSIONED` (5) proposer on the OP Sepolia DisputeGameFactory to `0x9884C33C65111DA7Bbed0e63cD2392F503b135F5` with `SetDisputeGameArgs`, signed by the L1PAO (impl, anchorStateRegistry and zero bond kept live). The batcher and signer are split so the signer can rotate later (Oct 30) than the batcher and proposer (Oct 15).

Blocking: the OP Sepolia SystemConfig owner is today the EOA `0xfd1D2e729aE8eEe2E146c033bf4400fE75284301`, not the FoundationUpgradeSafe. It has to `transferOwnership` to the FoundationUpgradeSafe outside this repo before sep/112 and sep/114 can execute; until then both configs override `SystemConfig.owner()` (slot `0x33`) for simulation, same pattern as the Unichain/Soneium batcher tasks. The OPE unsafe block signer in sep/114 is the `0xdead00000000000000000000000000002002dead` placeholder.

Nonce pins follow sep/110-111 (Unichain Sepolia): sep/112 FUS 79, sep/113 L1PAO 58 / FUS 80 / SC 72, sep/114 FUS 81. sep/115 is left free for U21 Sepolia (Nov 9), and Soneium Minato moves to sep/116-118 (#1565, now stacked on this PR). Calldata re-derived with `cast` in the docs, and `just simulate-stack` passes with the VALIDATION.md hashes on both signing paths.
